name: Zero-shot RNA language model benchmark
description: Measures zero-shot performance of RNA language models on structural, functional, and evolutionary prediction tasks.
evaluation_method: AUROC / Spearman/Pearson correlation / accuracy / F1 depending on subtask
general_score_metric: AUROC for classification-style structural/functional predictions (and correlation metrics for continuous-valued tasks)
reputation: An emerging benchmark in the computational RNA modeling community used to probe zero-shot capabilities of sequence models, but not yet a broadly standardized suite.
notes: Potential contamination risk from overlap between training corpora and evaluation families; heterogeneous task types and dataset sizes across tasks; specialized (non-LLM) biological sequence modeling focus—performance sensitive to family-level splits and evolutionary redundancy.
